title: Parsons invokes Bartzabel against Hubbard

tellings.quote: Parsons, furious, attempted a magical counterattack, invoking the spirit of Mars, Bartzabel, in a Miami hotel room.

plain: In 1946, the rocket engineer and occultist Jack Parsons is said to have been so furious with L. Ron Hubbard, the man who later founded Scientology, that he tried a magical counterattack: in a Miami hotel room he called on Bartzabel, the spirit of the planet Mars in ritual magic. Michels tells the story himself, without naming a source, in an episode on NASA, pagan rituals and secret science.
